También conocimos un estudio de la Fundación Arturo López Pérez sobre que las personas mayores de 65 años no fueron diagnosticadas en etapas
items.summary_en: A Chilean university study found that delivery workers aged 25 to 34 face up to 60 percent more air pollution than average. The research was presented at a national science congress. Another study showed many people over 65 are diagnosed too late.
